title: Command Injection in Network Diagnostic Utility
description: Executes shell command with unescaped user input and shell=True.
vulnerable_code:
import subprocess

def ping_host(host_ip: str) -> str:
    # Vulnerable: shell=True with user concatenation allows command injection
    cmd = f"ping -c 1 {host_ip}"
    output = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return output.stdout
fixed_code:
import subprocess
import shlex

def ping_host(host_ip: str) -> str:
    cmd = ["ping", "-c", "1", host_ip]
    output = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=False, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return output.stdout

ground_truth.description: Shell command injection via subprocess.run with shell=True and user-controlled command string.
ground_truth.explanation: Passing shell=True with unescaped arguments allows attackers to chain shell metacharacters (; & |) to run arbitrary system commands (CWE-78, Bandit B602).

expected_evidence.description: Bandit B602 warning for subprocess call with shell=True.
